text:
incident-bot: PAGED jessica — P1 latency spike detected in us-west-2 inference fleet. p95 > 1200ms for 6m; error rate +11% for hosted API (model=redwood-medium). Pager reason: sustained p95 breach.

jessica: ack. I'm oncall. Starting triage. Can someone grab traces + perf counters and check recent infra changes? @kevin @maddy

kevin: grabbing traces now from trace-store for the 18:12-18:18 window. early quick view: a cluster of long spans in runtime::kv_cache::lookup and scheduler::enqueue at p95. sharing a couple of spans below.

kevin: ```
span id=0x7f3a duration=870ms service=runtime op=kv_cache::lookup
  -> child span runtime::decode 120ms
  -> child span kernel-sched 620ms (blocked)
span id=0x7f4b duration=340ms service=runtime op=scheduler::enqueue
  -> notes: wait on cpu-runqueue, ctx-switch spikes
```

maddy: perf counters from one affected node (node-uw2-12):
```
# perf stat -e cycles,context-switches,cpu-migrations -p $(pidof redwood-runtime) sleep 10
    12,345,678,900 cycles
       14,523 context-switches
           32 cpu-migrations
```
Looks like huge context-switch increase relative to baseline. Also saw increased softirqs.

ravi: I just checked node upgrade history — those nodes got a kernel roll forward 3h ago: linux-5.19.12 -> linux-5.19.14 with sched patch (internal change: fairer wake/wake_affine). rollout batch id: krnl-roll-2026-03-17-16.

jessica: that aligns timeline. We should treat kernel change as primary hypothesis for p95 tail. Hypotheses: 1) kernel sched change => runqueue jitter; 2) some runtime scheduling bug interacting with new kernel; 3) external network causing KV cache thrash.

daniel: quick mitigation: cordon the nodes with new kernel and drain pods to stable pool (nodes still on 5.19.12). If drain is slow we can also scale up stable pool to absorb traffic.

zara: starting cordon + drain on 3 nodes part of the batch: node-uw2-12, -13, -14. Command: ```kubectl cordon node-uw2-12 && kubectl drain node-uw2-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --timeout=10m```

deploy-bot: evict-job created for node-uw2-12 (pods: runtime-5, sidecar-2). ETA ~3m per node for graceful termination.

kevin: continuing trace analysis. Noticed kernel_syscall spans with long futex waits prior to scheduler block. sample trace snippet: ```
... kernel_syscall futex_wait 450ms -> sched_yield -> ctx_switch 300ms ...
```

maddy: dug into perf top on node-uw2-12: top hot functions: __schedule, pick_next_task_fair, __futex_wait. That matches scheduler stalls.

ravi: rollback plan internal: we can reimage nodes to previous AMI with 5.19.12, but reimaging ~10–12m/node. Prefer draining to older nodes if capacity exists.

jessica: mitigation decision: 1) cordon/drain the three suspect nodes (zara doing). 2) scale up stable pool by +20% (kevin to trigger). 3) keep traffic routing stable (no model fallback yet). 4) capture full perf + trace bundles for RCA.

kevin: scaling stable pool now: ```terraform apply -var='stable_pool_desired=60' modules/k8s-autoscale```. API capacity increased, routing should shift within 2m.

zara: node-uw2-12 drained successfully, pods moved. node-13 draining. visible p95 improving on dashboards: from 1250ms -> 600ms in the last 3m.

incident-bot: Incident annotated: mitigation_in_progress. Customer-impact: medium — increased latency for some hosted API requests, no large error spike after drain.

jessica: collecting artifacts for RCA: - trace bundle (trace-store id t-3187654321) - perf logs (s3://redwood-ops/p95/3187654321/perf-node-uw2-12.log) - kernel changelog (krnl-roll-2026-03-17-16/metadata.json) - pod logs (s3://redwood-ops/p95/3187654321/pods.tar.gz)

kevin: adding a timeline draft in-thread: 
  - 16:02: kernel rollout started (batch krnl-roll-2026-03-17-16)
  - 18:09: first p95 uptick detected by alerting (p95 ~ 400ms)
  - 18:12: sustained p95 > 1000ms for 6m, pager fired (3187654321)
  - 18:14: oncall ack + initial traces (kevin)
  - 18:16: cordon + drain begins on 3 nodes (zara)
  - 18:22: p95 trending down to ~600ms, mitigation continues

ravi: next steps for RCA: reproduce on a test node with same kernel, run stress tests with synthetic KV-cache traffic + perf and tracers. Also bisect kernel patch set if reproduction is reliable.

maddy: note for postmortem: capture baseline perf counters for same workload on 5.19.12 vs 5.19.14 and include flamegraphs. Will start capture on a repro node.

jessica: assigning follow-ups: @ravi lead kernel reproduction + bisect; @maddy perf + flamegraphs; @kevin compile trace timeline + annotate spans; @zara validation of node rollback plan. I'll draft the incident summary once we have artifacts.

kevin: one more quick data point — p50 barely moved, p95 moved a lot. That strongly implies tail scheduler stalls, aligns with kernel scheduling path.

zara: node-uw2-13 drained. p95 now 430ms. All three nodes drained and cordoned.

jessica: thanks all. Moving this thread to RCA backlog channel after we collect artifacts. Leaving this incident thread open until we have confirmed repro and next actions. :white_check_mark:
